scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
